properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the whole-design reasoning walk never reaches a claim that only an objection points to, such as a refuted conjecture. Its roots are "concluded by a step, premise of none" (plus contested Decisions), and its neighbour rule follows an objection to the claim it is AGAINST only from that claim's side, never from the objection to its target. The rule was written 2026-10-16, before 0.86.0 gave a conjecture its own reading
properties.source: the root-cause skill, run by Claude in this session on @ajs's "/root-cause double-counting and a walk that never reaches refuted claims"; measured on reflow2 main 5a94e83 locally and on flo2.io 0.86.0
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-18.

① OBSERVED:
- reasoning_report with no claim, on bbcd344a71ff1cbd, returns roots [req:h-answer, req:h-where-line1-breaks, req:h-where-line2-breaks, req:thm-fundamental-theorem-of-arithmetic] and walks 66 claims.
- req:conj-h-unique-factorization and req:conj-h-euclid are not among them, although each is refuted ("refuted by … which holds") by a counterexample the walk DOES reach (req:h-441-two-factorizations, whose objects_to names the conjecture).
- The same on d2ea1acfee6090c8: roots name the Euler counterexample but never req:conjecture-euler-polynomial.
- EXPECTED: a whole-design read covers every claim of the reasoning, refuted ones included.
- NOT affected: reasoning_report with `claim` set to the conjecture reads it correctly ("refuted"), and get_node gives its statement_reading.

② PRECEDENT: none. reflow2 and flo2 had only today's flo2 #169 records, which work around it by asking reasoning_report about each objected-to claim one at a time.

③ CANDIDATES:
- (a) IMPLEMENTATION: the root rule plus the neighbour rule leave out a claim reached only by an outgoing objection.
- (b) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG, OR THE ENCODING IS: the designer drew CONTRADICTS backwards, or the counterexample does not hold.
- (c) OUTSIDE reflow2: flo2 drops the claims.
- (d) CHANGE: the walk (d0fad20, 2026-10-16) predates statement_kind conjecture and refuted (4879171, #764, 2026-10-17). #764 rewrote 170 lines of reasoning.rs but its conjecture test reads only get_node, so no test ever asked the whole-design walk about an unconcluded refuted claim.

④⑤ MEASURED:
- On the committed fixture (local main build, no gateway): roots are the same 4, 66 walked, both conjectures ABSENT, both counterexamples PRESENT. So (c) is REFUTED.
- On flo2.io, the conjecture's own reasoning_report shows the counterexample as an objection with standing "refutes" and truth "holds". The edge runs counterexample → conjecture, correctly. So (b) is REFUTED.
- (a) SURVIVES: read in the code, and reproduced.
- (d) is CONFIRMED from git log and the test files. tests/a_line_of_reasoning_reads_back.rs asserts roots only for designs with no conjecture.

⑥ CLASS: the walk's reach is a hand-kept list of the edges it follows, and a new kind of claim (an unconcluded statement that only an objection reaches) arrived without the list learning it. Rung 1's Euler conjecture shows it predates today.

PROPOSED FIX (not built):
- The walk follows an opposing CONTRADICTS in BOTH directions, so an objection's target is part of the reasoning.
- The roots also take any statement that is an objection's target and is not otherwise reached. That covers a bare conjecture refuted by a bare counterexample.
- Pin a CLASS invariant: the whole-design walk covers every node that has a statement_reading or a proof_status, or that is an endpoint of an opposing CONTRADICTS. Run it on both trial fixtures.
- flo2 #169's extra per-claim calls can then go (flo2 side, after the release).

COULD NOT ESTABLISH: whether any reader relies on refuted claims being absent from the whole-design walk. None was found.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
